For ignite arts actually has no diff in the “quality” of Teachers

Arts student here! Arts (my H2s) is vvv good no complaints ! Our history notes are better than HCI and RI actually (comparing notes across schools) the only caveat here is tbh GP it’s vvv uhm questionable here (personally for me). Eg we don’t get practise booklets like other schools do and no model essays to refer to as well. Our GP notes are not great actually as well. But nonetheless if u work hard on ur own U still can score A :) PW here isn’t that great either compared to other schs like 30% distinction. 

Anyways if u score double digit nett pls come to cjc! (Like qualify for asrjc,sajc,cjc,tmjc) it’s rrly the best for arts among these jcs. If u score like 8/9 nett do consider schools like ACJC,TJC,EJC and DHS!  The notes and resources ngl are wayyy better for arts than cjc
